results.name: toolz-sliding-window
results.summary: Fixed the sliding_window function in toolz/itertoolz.py by changing the islice argument from i+1 to i. This ensures that the first window starts at index 0. Verified that the pytest test for sliding_window passes and the doctests in the function's docstring also pass.

results.name: more-itertools-tail
results.summary: Fixed the tail function in more_itertools/recipes.py by ensuring the start index for islice is non-negative when the requested tail length exceeds the iterable size. Changed `islice(iterable, size - n, None)` to `islice(iterable, max(size - n, 0), None)`. This resolves the ValueError when n > size.

results.name: humanize-naturalsize
results.summary: Fixed the filesize.naturalsize function to use base 1000 for decimal mode (when binary=False and gnu=False). The issue was that the function was using base 1024 for all non-GNU modes, causing decimal conversions to be incorrect. Changed the base selection to use 1000 for decimal mode. All tests now

results.name: jmespath-prefix-suffix
results.summary: Swapped the implementations of _func_ends_with and _func_starts_with in jmespath/functions.py. The ends_with function was incorrectly using startswith and starts_with was using endswith. After fixing, all function-related compliance tests pass.

results.name: click-intrange-clamp
results.summary: Fixed the IntRange clamping logic for open bounds: changed _clamp method in src/click/types.py to add direction instead of subtract when clamping to an open bound. This ensures that IntRange(0, min_open=True, clamp=True) converts '0' to 1 (the next valid value) instead of -1. All tests in tests/test

results.name: jinja-batch-filter
results.summary: Fixed the batch filter in src/jinja2/filters.py by changing the condition from `len(tmp) > linecount` to `len(tmp) == linecount`. This ensures that batches are yielded when the temporary list reaches exactly the specified linecount, preventing extra items in each batch. The change was verified by ru

results.name: packaging-canonicalize
results.summary: Fixed canonicalize_name in src/packaging/utils.py to replace '.' with '-' in addition to '_' before condensing repeated hyphens. This makes it comply with PEP 503 normalization. Verified by running the pytest suite for canonicalize_name and the full test suite; all tests pass.

results.name: pyparsing-lineno
results.summary: Fixed the lineno function in pyparsing/util.py by adding 1 to the count of newlines, so that the first line is reported as line 1 instead of line 0. This change made the failing test (testCStyleCommentParser) pass, and the full test suite passes.

results.name: tomli-unicode-escape
results.summary: Fixed the parsing of \\uXXXX escape sequences in basic strings by changing the hex length from 3 to 4 in parse_basic_str_escape function. This resolves the failures in the test suite where documents with such escapes were either failing to load or loading with incorrect text. All tests now pass.
